pokedexEntries.go: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.

pokedexEntries.si: Even in the most vicious storm, this POKéMON plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.

pokedexEntries.cr: It loves violent thunder. The space between its horns flickers bluish-white when it is charging energy.

pokedexEntries.rs: ELEKID stores electricity in its body. If it touches metal and accidentally discharges all its built-up electricity, this POKéMON begins swinging its arms in circles to recharge itself.

pokedexEntries.fr: Even in the most vicious storm, this POKéMON plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.

pokedexEntries.lg: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.

pokedexEntries.em: If it touches metal and discharges the electricity it has stored in its body, an ELEKID begins swinging its arms in circles to recharge itself.

pokedexEntries.dp: It generates electricity by whirling its arms. However, it can’t store the energy it makes.

pokedexEntries.pt: A weak electric current flows between its horns. Sticking a hand there shocks the unwary.

pokedexEntries.hg: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it only charges up a little bit.

pokedexEntries.ss: Even in the most vicious storm, this Pokémon plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.

pokedexEntries.bw: A weak electric current flows between its horns. Sticking a hand there shocks the unwary.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Spinning its arms around to generate electricity makes the area between its horns shine light blue.

pokedexEntries.x: It generates electricity by whirling its arms. However, it can’t store the energy it makes.

pokedexEntries.y: Spinning its arms around to generate electricity makes the area between its horns shine light blue.

pokedexEntries.oras: Elekid stores electricity in its body. If it touches metal and accidentally discharges all its built-up electricity, this Pokémon begins swinging its arms in circles to recharge itself.

pokedexEntries.su: When it’s in a house, electrical outlets serve as its baby bottles. It sucks down electricity.

pokedexEntries.mo: This Pokémon is constantly fighting with Togedemaru that try to steal its electricity. It’s a pretty even match.

pokedexEntries.us: When it hears the crash of thunder, Elekid’s mood improves. It can be useful to record that sound and play it when Elekid’s feeling down.

pokedexEntries.um: When its horns shine a bluish white, that’s the sign it’s fully charged. You’ll get a shocking jolt if you touch it!

pokedexEntries.sw: When a storm approaches, this Pokémon gets restless. Once Elekid hears the sound of thunder, it gets full-on rowdy.

pokedexEntries.sh: It’s not good at storing electricity yet. This Pokémon sneaks into people’s homes, looking for electrical outlets to eat electricity from.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It generates electricity by whirling its arms. However, it can’t store the energy it makes.

pokedexEntries.la: They generate electricity by spinning their arms. During a thunderstorm, if one hears the lively voices of children out in the wilderness, what one is actually hearing are the voices of Elekid.

pokedexEntries.sc: It loves violent thunder. The space between its horns flickers bluish white when it is charging energy.

pokedexEntries.vi: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it only charges up a little bit.
